serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings/Order, maintenance_bookings, unassigned_services) for bookedMin, service_capacities reserved columns as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative booked load from that bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is service_capacities.reserved_*, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series — the same ceiling applies to every day of the window; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured rather than a ceiling of zero
